IS 17424 : Part 1 : 2020 Glossary of Ayurvedic Terminology - Part 1 Standardized Terminology for Fundamental Principles

ICS 01.040.11, 11.020.99 FAD 26

1 SCOPE

This standard (Part 1) covers description/ definition of terminologies related to Fundamental Principles in Ayurveda. Other standards in the series cover the description/ definition of terminologies related to diagnosis and etiological factors, foods and beverages, medicinal preparations, signs and symptoms, treatment modalities, Pharmacology and Pharmacognosy, structure and function in Ayurveda.
